steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: GCSE RS requires you to understand why people commit crimes and how religion explains good and evil. Both Christianity and Islam teach that humans have free will and are responsible for their choices. | RS Exam Tips — Good, Evil and the Causes of Crime: 1. For Good, Evil and the Causes of Crime questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5.
